correctness.rationale: The proof fixes the mean-zero spectral projections even for disconnected factors. Orthogonal Laplacian join decomposition yields the exact PSD identity, including cross-factor collisions and the only top-frequency resonance. A complement-graph component calculation shows Q_G strictly positive on the component-constant subspace for every order at least three; hence adding F_s cannot change rank, while direct K2 calculation gives exactly one added rank. Singleton cases and equality of reduced/full ranks for connected factors are checked. Exact rational verifier reconstructs 100 graph pairs and 3,800 matrix entries; unrestricted proof does not depend on enumeration.

value.rationale: Classifies an all-graph operation: connected-factor Laplacian average-mixing rank is additive except exactly the K2 factors; disconnected cases have a complete reduced-rank formula. It explains why all other top-frequency coincidences fail to change rank, and separates structural nullity from graph-specific computations. This is a natural transport invariant and an exact, unrestricted classification, rather than a finite small-graph increment.
